output: html_document
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
install.packages("rlang")
packageVersion("rlang")
library(tidyverse)
library(ggrepel)
```


```{r PrepareData}
nomads <- meridian_nomad_index_2026_09_26
names(nomads) <- as.character(nomads[5, ])
nomads <- nomads[-c(1:5), ]
```

```{r convertData}
nomads <- nomads %>%
mutate(across(-c(city, country), as.numeric))
```

```{r Benchmarks }
cost_med <- median(
  nomads$essentials_usd_month,
  na.rm = TRUE)

safety_med <- median(
  nomads$safety_index,
  na.rm = TRUE)

internet_med <- median(
  nomads$internet_mbps,
  na.rm = TRUE)
```

```{r qualifyingCities}
tradeoff <- nomads %>%
  mutate(
     cheap = essentials_usd_month < cost_med,
     safe = safety_index > safety_med,
     fast_internet = internet_mbps > internet_med,
     
all_three = if_else( cheap & safe & fast_internet,
      "Meets all three",
      "Does not meet all three"))

tradeoff %>%
  count(all_three) %>%
  mutate(percent = n / sum(n) * 100)


tradeoff %>%
  filter(all_three == "Meets all three") %>%
  select(
    city,
    country,
    essentials_usd_month,
    safety_index,
    internet_mbps
  ) %>%
  arrange(essentials_usd_month)
```


```{r Visuals}
ggplot(
  tradeoff,
  aes(
    x = essentials_usd_month,
    y = internet_mbps)) +

  annotate(
    "rect",
    xmin = -Inf,
    xmax = cost_med,
    ymin = internet_med,
    ymax = Inf,
    fill = "#f3e6b8",
    alpha = 0.35) +

  geom_vline(
    xintercept = cost_med,
    linetype = "dashed",
    color = "grey55",
    linewidth = 0.5) +

  geom_hline(
    yintercept = internet_med,
    linetype = "dashed",
    color = "grey55",
    linewidth = 0.5) +

  geom_point(
    data = tradeoff %>%
      filter(all_three == "Does not meet all three"),
    color = "#c9c9c9",
    size = 3.5,
    alpha = 0.40) +

  geom_point(
    data = tradeoff %>%
      filter(all_three == "Meets all three"),
    color = "#176B87",
    size = 4.5,
    alpha = 0.95) +

  geom_text_repel(
    data = tradeoff %>%
      filter(
        city %in% c(
          "Hoi An",
          "Da Nang",
          "Bucharest",
          "Granada",
          "Osaka",
          "Florianópolis" ) ),
    aes(label = city),
    size = 3.7,
    fontface = "bold",
    box.padding = 0.5,
    point.padding = 0.4,
    min.segment.length = 0) +

  annotate(
    "text",
    x = 650,
    y = 285,
    label = "THE SWEET SPOT",
    fontface = "bold",
    color = "#8a6500",
    size = 4) +

  coord_cartesian(
    xlim = c(400, 3200),
    ylim = c(0, 300)) +

  labs(
    title = "The Digital Nomad Sweet Spot",
    subtitle = "Mapping cities that are affordable, safe, and have fast internet",
    x = "Monthly essentials (USD)",
    y = "Internet speed (Mbps)",
    caption = "Teal cities beat the median on cost, safety, and internet speed.") +

  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +

  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(
      size = 22,
      face = "bold",
      margin = margin(b = 5) ),

    plot.subtitle = element_text(
      size = 13,
      color = "grey30",
      margin = margin(b = 15) ),

    axis.title = element_text(
      face = "bold"),

    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),

    panel.grid.major = element_line(
      color = "#eeeeee",
      linewidth = 0.4),

    plot.caption = element_text(
      color = "grey45",
      size = 9))
```
